title: Type Fly
description: An album title set flat under its cover. Hover or press and every letter lifts off the line, grows its depth and flies into a square ring around the record, the album's own shape in 3D; drag to spin the ring and the sleeve turns to show its tracklist. Let go and the letters fly home in order.
intent: One type mechanic finished to the edge: characters fly from their 2D line into an extruded 3D arrangement on per-letter springs, interruptible at every moment.
